title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
topics: Thread relief groove geometry and dimensions
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must be provided according to dimensional ranges: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm
Relief grooves for thread must be made in case where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove dimensions vary based on pitch (P): P<1.25, 1.5≤P≤1.75≤2, 2.5≤P≤3
Grooves follow UNI regulation (shown as dashed line) and TRASMITAL specifications (shown as solid line)
Possible specific grooves must be indicated in details in drawing
dimensions: For grinding zones 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.1mm, radius R 1.6, angle 30°, tolerance ±0.1mm
For grinding zones 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.2mm, radius R 1.6, angle 30°, tolerance ±0.2mm
For grinding zones 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 0.3mm, radius R 2.5, angle 30°, tolerances ±0.3/±0.4mm
For grinding zones >125mm: width 7mm, depth ±0.2mm, radius R4.0, angle 30°, tolerance ±0.3mm
tolerances: Grinding zone >125mm: depth ±0.2mm (one side) and ±0.3mm (other side)
inspection: Verify groove dimensions against UNI4386 standard or TRASMITAL specifications
Check groove width, depth, radius, and angle per size range
Confirm groove location at grinding zone transitions or thread shoulders
Verify any specific grooves are detailed in drawing
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves are required to provide clearance for grinding tools
Thread relief grooves prevent interference at shoulder transitions
Groove geometry must match pitch range for threaded applications
Specific grooves beyond standard dimensions require drawing details
30° angle standard for grinding relief grooves
60°-75° angle range for thread relief grooves
training_guidance: NX agent must automatically insert relief grooves at grinding zone boundaries based on diameter range
For shafts with diameters 18-50mm, create groove with width=2.5mm, depth=0.1mm, R=1.6mm, angle=30°
For shafts with diameters 51-80mm, create groove with width=3mm, depth=0.2mm, R=1.6mm, angle=30°
For shafts with diameters 81-125mm, create groove with width=4.5mm, depth=0.3mm, R=2.5mm, angle=30°
For shafts with diameters >125mm, create groove with width=7mm, R=4.0mm, angle=30°
At thread-to-shoulder interfaces, insert thread relief groove based on thread pitch: use table to select R, A, B, T1, T2 parameters
Thread relief groove angle should be between 60° and 75°
Apply tolerances automatically per size range or flag for special detailing if non-standard
Validate that all grinding transitions and thread shoulders have appropriate relief grooves
Compare generated geometry against both UNI4386 standard and TRASMITAL specifications
summary: This page defines two critical relief groove standards: TAB-001 for grinding zones and TAB-002 for threaded areas. Grinding relief grooves are dimensioned in four size ranges (18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, >125mm) with specific widths, depths, radii, and 30° angles, compared against UNI4386. Thread relief grooves are required at shoulder transitions and are dimensioned based on thread pitch (P<1.25, 1.5-2, 2.5-3) with 60°-75° angles. Both standards include detailed tolerances and require special grooves to be indicated in drawings.
